name: Occult
overview: Scripture clearly condemns involvement with the occult, warning against witchcraft, familiar spirits, and wizardry as defiling practices forbidden by God. The Lord commands His people not to tolerate witches or seek after those with familiar spirits, emphasizing severe consequences including being cut off from the community or death. Additionally, God instructs His people to avoid adopting the abominable customs of surrounding nations, including the worship of celestial bodies, which can lead to idolatry. These verses underscore God's holiness and the necessity for His people to remain separate from occult practices.
